# FG-CI-0032

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`merge-queue`](../../ops/runbooks/merge-queue.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_train_whose_members_break_a_reference_together_never_lands` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: マージキューの文書検査（forge/doc-lint）を通らなかったため、MR はキューから外されました。理由と問題の一覧を確かめて直してから、もう一度キューに入れてください。
- en: The merge request did not pass the merge queue's document check (forge/doc-lint) and was removed from the queue. Read the reason and the listed problems, fix them and add it to the queue again.
- id: Merge request tidak lolos pemeriksaan dokumen antrean merge (forge/doc-lint) dan dikeluarkan dari antrean. Baca alasan dan daftar masalahnya, perbaiki, lalu masukkan lagi ke antrean.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 18 S1 (ADR-0037 (b)): before a merge-queue train lands, the queue lints the documents of the train's last step — the tree that would become the target's tip — with the same function as `forge/doc-lint` on a head and `gstn doc lint` (forge-checks train_lint, injected into the queue's worker by `forge serve`). `reason=doc_lint_failed`: that tree has a document problem the train's base (the target's tip the train was built on) does not have; a problem is the same one when its path, rule and referenced id are the same. Typically two merge requests that each pass alone and break a reference together: one deletes or renames a document, the other starts to cite it. The queue looked for the first step whose tree shows a new problem while the step before it shows none (a binary search over the train's steps; no new train is built for it) and removed that step's entry; the other entries went back to the queue and are rebuilt in order. `reason=doc_lint_base_not_clean`: the repository is strict — `.forge/repo.yml` at the base says `merge_queue.doc_lint_strict: true`, or that file cannot be read as a valid one (FG-REPO-0024), which never relaxes the rule — the train adds no problem, but problems of the base are still in the last step: every entry of the batch is removed and nothing lands until one train leaves the target clean. Broken references the repository's migration setting lowers to warnings (plan 13 Q13) do not count. The lint applies when a member changes a `.md` file or `.forge/doctypes/**`, and always in a strict repository. Not a server fault; the target did not move for the removed entry.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge serve` logs `forge.merge_queue.entry_removed` with `error_code`, `request_id` (the batch's), `queue_id`, `batch_id`, `entry_id`, `merge_request_id`, `reason`, `train_sha`, `step` (the entry's 1-based position in the train; absent for `doc_lint_base_not_clean`) and `problems` (the first 20 as `rule:path:id`, the id empty when the rule has none). The whole list with files and lines is the `forge/doc-lint` check run on the train: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <train_sha>. `gstn queue list --project <id> --target <branch>` shows the removed entry with its reason. To see the problem on a working tree: merge the target into the branch and run gstn doc lint.

## 対処 (fix)

`doc_lint_failed`: merge or rebase the target into the merge request's branch, repair the reference (restore the document, or cite the id that exists now), push the new version and add the merge request to the queue again (gstn queue add). An auto-merge merge request stays stopped (`merge_queue_doc_lint_failed`) until its head changes. `doc_lint_base_not_clean`: land one merge request that repairs every document problem of the target (it lands when its own merge result is clean), then add the others again; or, when the repository should not be strict, remove `merge_queue.doc_lint_strict` from `.forge/repo.yml` with a merge request that itself leaves the target clean, or repair the invalid file. Nothing to change on the server; runbook merge-queue describes the train lint and its switch (`merge_queue.train_lint_budget_ms = 0`).
